_comment: Cross-engine parity contract for the visible crop inset-rect computation.
Single source of truth shared by BOTH video engines:
Each engine has a test that reads this file and asserts it reproduces every case.
Given a local box (width x height) and four crop percentages (0..100), both
engines must produce the same visible rectangle [xMin,yMin .. xMax,yMax] in local
Scope: NON-overlapping crops only (left+right <= 100 AND top+bottom <= 100), the
region where both engines agree exactly.
KNOWN INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE (NOT covered): when opposing crops overlap, native
scales both edges down proportionally (centered collapse) while web keeps the
first edge and clamps the second. See each engine's crop test for that case.
